sentences.text: Pollari Works Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-15 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-15, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-24.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but a new boat repair firm shows no technology or growth evidence yet.
